text_block_list.text:
A few days later. Dropping by the track, I spotted Victoire Pisa
speaking to a friend with a solemn expression.

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Horsegirl Friend
text_block_list.text:
—Yep. That was the deal with my parents when I entered the academy.
If it looked like I wasn't going to make it, I'd go back home and attend a regular school.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Is... that so...

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Horsegirl Friend
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, don't look so down, Pisa~. I already knew it myself anyway.
I've worked hard for three years and haven't even placed in a single mock race, you know?

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Horsegirl Friend
text_block_list.text:
So, yeah. This next mock race is my last. If it doesn't work out, I'm heading home!
And my dream of shining on the racetrack... I'll entrust it all to you, Pisa!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...I understand.
I know this is simply the reality of such a competitive world.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Even so—it is heartbreaking.

A time always comes when one must consider their future and decide whether to press on or step down.
For an athlete, it is an unavoidable crossroads.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...If this is truly what she wants, I cannot stop her.
However... she said 'this next one is my last.'

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Her heart is still... connected to her dream of racing.
If that is so... I want to do whatever I can to help her.
—The next day.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Phew...!

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Horsegirl Friend
text_block_list.text:
W-Whoa, that really looks just like my running style...
To think you can even mimic that... you're so versatile, Pisa.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Let's work together to refine your form before the mock race.
I know you can still shave down your time.

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Horsegirl Friend
text_block_list.text:
B-But Pisa, aren't you running in a mock race against Rose and the others too?
They're not opponents you can take lightly. You shouldn't be wasting time looking after me—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It will be fine.
I just need to stay behind and train extra afterward.

If she plans to coach her friend through demonstrations while still going full throttle on her own training...
she's going to severely overwork herself.

Her rivals aren't easy enough for her to beat while dividing her attention.
With her own debut on the line, she can't afford to neglect her preparation.
choice_data_list: And yet, what she wants is—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
To stand beside others. To connect our hearts. To banish loneliness from this world.
I believe that if we do, we can one day create a circle of hope that connects the entire world.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...I want to keep your heart anchored to racing.

—Yes. She wants to connect.
To bridge the people in front of her with the things they hold dear.
choice_data_list: That's why... please, let me help.
That's why... I want to help you.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
So this is your plan for improving her form, Trainer... Yes, this will definitely suit her.
Let's head outside and try it right away.
choice_data_list: Make sure you save some energy for yourself, okay?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Yes, thank you for your concern.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Hah...!

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Horsegirl Friend
text_block_list.text: Haaah!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Fufu, look at how much your time has improved over these past five days.
choice_data_list: It's great to celebrate, but make sure to take proper breaks.
I'm glad to see it, but don't forget to take proper breaks.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
I'll go fetch some tea for us, then.

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Horsegirl Friend
text_block_list.text:
...Man, she really looks like she's having fun even though it's someone else's training.
Just watching her makes the future feel a little brighter. Haha, maybe it's just my imagination.
—And then came the day of the mock race.

Victoire Pisa's friend gave everything she had, setting a new personal best—
and finished her final challenge in 6th place.

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Horsegirl Friend
text_block_list.text:
Ah—it really... hurts... it hurts so much...
Pisa... show me hope... Show me hope, Pisaaa...!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...So, you carry the hopes of your friend. But—
I shall not commit the discourtesy of holding back...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Circumstances or not, none of that matters on the track.
Don't take it personally, Pisa...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—I will not let my guard down for a moment. I intend to defeat you with everything I have.
Precisely because I know what you are capable of.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(...The fact that she is leaving the academy cannot be changed now...
Even so—)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Even so, if nothing else... I must leave hope in her heart...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaah...!

—A few days later.
The day came for Victoire Pisa's friend to leave the academy.

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Horsegirl Friend
text_block_list.text:
...You know, it's strange. Even though I lost and I'm leaving this place,
your run is burned into my mind. Like it's telling me never to forget it.

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Horsegirl Friend
text_block_list.text:
I promise you. Even after I go back home, I'll always love racing.
Because you... reconnected me to my love for racing, Pisa!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Please take care of yourself.
And... until we meet again.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
........................
In the end, it did not turn out to be the best possible outcome.

Her friend had left, and Pisa herself hadn't received any scout offers
after falling short down the final stretch due to lack of preparation.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Her saying she will continue to love racing...
is my only solace.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
choice_data_list: Might leave nothing behind for yourself.
Might leave nothing behind for yourself.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, you may be right.
choice_data_list: But the hope you weave will remain in someone's heart.
Yet the hope you weave will live on in someone's heart.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
choice_data_list: And I want to support that journey of yours—connecting feelings, connecting bonds.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Then—shall we connect them together?
Until we connect all the hearts in the world and banish all loneliness.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Believing that even after the rain of sorrow falls... skies of hope will appear—
